<a href="Item-iron-hoe.md" title="Iron hoe"><img src="icons/59.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Iron hoe"></a>

Tills grass or dirt into farmland and cuts leaves faster. Tools currently have no durability loss.

| Tool tier | Iron |
